owner_instruction: The owner agreed that imported information such as an album year must remain, accepting permanent imported metadata, saved filenames, maintenance reports and Undo history, with retention nonblocking for release.
scope: Successfully imported Discogs metadata, including year, genre, track numbers and CD catalogue fields, plus saved metadata-derived filenames, maintenance reports and metadata Undo history. Retain these until the user changes or removes them; lookup expiry, restart and offline use must not delete or revert them.
rationale: Preserve durable personal-library information and the record of changes. The owner elects to keep this workflow without making unresolved provider-permission interpretation a prerequisite for release. This records a product and release decision, not confirmed provider permission.
outside_scope: Freshness validation of new imports and temporary search results/previews
Unsaved transient CD content in system Now Playing
Source correspondence, branding, notice delivery and privacy review
Library schema migration or historical-provider backfill
Vendor binary adoption, initial commit, publication, installed-app updates and provider communication
